description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and configuration functions for different hardware boards in an OpenWRT build system.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of a firmware image based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the appropriate upgrade procedure depending on the board model.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data for specific boards.
